scan.title: Scan this code on the panel
scan.description: On the panel, open Settings and tap **Scan QR code**. If it cannot read it, type the address `{url}` and the code `{code}`. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Press Submit when the panel says it is connected.

error.not_scanned: The panel has not used the code yet. If it expired, this is a new one.

abort.already_configured: This panel already exists: remove it first to add it again.
abort.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no internal URL: set one in Settings > System > Network.

intercoms.title: Intercoms
intercoms.description: The panel registers with them over SIP, to answer the door and talk to it. DMSS is not affected. You can leave the list empty.

data_description.intercoms: The name must match the last part of the marc2d/doorbell topic that the doorbell automation publishes to.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Their video is shown in the panel's menu. You can leave the list empty.

data_description.cameras: If you have intercoms, choose one to offer Talk on that camera.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: The weather and the forecast next to the clock.

mqtt.title: Doorbell, sensors and siren (MQTT)
mqtt.description: The broker carries the doorbell ring, the droid's state, the sensors and the siren. Turned off, all of those stop.

data_description.sensors: Light, battery, battery temperature and charging. Off: Home Assistant removes those entities.
data_description.siren: Lets Home Assistant sound the panel's siren at full volume. Off: it removes the entity and the panel ignores the command.

init.title: Panel settings
init.description: Open what you want to change. Submitting a page saves it, and the panel applies it right away.
